description: Run a Python library's standard-library unittest suite and user-specified issue scenario checks after edits, repeatedly if needed, and report a compact JSON pass/fail summary.

root.description: Project root relative to the current working directory; use '.' for the current directory.

package_path.description: Python package/module path or parent directory that must be importable during tests/checks. Use '.' if package is in the current directory.

tests_dir.description: Directory passed to `python -m unittest discover -s`; defaults to 'tests'.

top_level_dir.description: Directory passed to `python -m unittest discover -t`; defaults to '.'.

suite_command.description: Optional shell command used instead of unittest discover. If present, it is run with `sh -c` inside the root.

issue_checks.description: Issue scenario checks. Each item must contain a `name` and either Python source `code` run with `python -c`, or a script path `script` run with the project interpreter.

issue_checks.name: round-up
issue_checks.code:
from invoicer import Invoice, Line, Money
inv = Invoice('S', 'C', discount_percent=1)
inv.add(Line('A', 't', Money(50), 1))
inv.add(Line('B', 'u', Money(1), 1, taxable=False))
assert inv.taxable_amount() == Money(50)
